notes.title: 🛠️ First Development Update & Introduction
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691123/6fe2367b7d43bf2fe922d3e44250b003fa1960fe.gif"] Welcome, Warlords.

Thank you for visiting Yes, My Warlord! This is our first official development update, and we’re excited to finally share more about the project, where it’s headed, and what you can expect from the upcoming demo.


🧠 What Yes, My Warlord Is All About
You command a monstrous goblin warband clawing its way through a crumbling kingdom. Each week, desperate citizens, strange creatures, and scheming rivals come before your throne with demands, confessions, and absurd requests.
Your job? Decide their fate.
Will you execute the fool, bless the union, trade your soul, or feed them to the hounds?
Every choice shapes your reputation, your warband, and ultimately, your legacy.

If you like games like Yes, Your Grace, Reigns, or Papers, Please, but wish they were a bit darker, we think you’ll enjoy what’s brewing.


[hr][/hr]🧪 Current Progress & What’s Coming
Here’s where things stand:

🎮 The demo will feature roughly one-third of the full game’s content — including dozens of choice-driven scenes and events; release date for the demo is currently Q3 of 2025.

🧩 Major mechanics are already implemented, including faction loyalty, warband management, and progression systems

🧟‍♂️ One-third of the game’s characters already have their initial animations completed and will appear in the demo

🌍 Full localization for 29 languages is already done for both the store page and in-game demo

🔐 The full game will feature multiple difficulty levels, with half a dozen unlockable modes to challenge even the most ruthless warlords
